The error came from the word "input" in a comment (`# input pair`); the checker scans the source text and rejects that token. I reworded the comments, removed the dead `cmrr` expression and the stray `gm3` assignment, and left the circuit unchanged.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 11.0, 19.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff pair L (noise area / gain)
    "Itail": (44e-6, 25e-6, 90e-6),  # first-stage tail current
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror & output-device L (matched)
    "gmidp": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror / M7 gm/Id
    "I7":    (220e-6, 120e-6, 380e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (1.5e-12, 0.8e-12, 3e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.8, 1.0, 3.5),        # Rz = kRz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It = p["Itail"]; I1 = It / 2; I7 = p["I7"]; Cc = p["Cc"]
    gmidn_src = 12.0   # low vdsat for the tail (limited headroom at VCM=0.9 V)

    # bias diode, tail and second-stage sink: same L and gm/Id -> exact mirror ratios
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn_src, p["Ln"], Iref, vds=0.75)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn_src, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn_src, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6)
    # PMOS mirror load and output device (same L and gm/Id -> zero systematic offset)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kRz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m7.cgd
    Cout = CL + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cout + Cc * (C1 + Cout)))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)          # mirror pole
    dz = Cc * (Rz - 1 / gm7)
    fz = 1 / (2 * PI * dz) if dz > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))
    vdd = 1.8
    power = vdd * (Iref + It + I7)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    sr = min(It / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    settle = 0.5 / sr + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2 * (8 / 3) * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    cmrr_db = db(2 * m3.gm / m5.gds)
    psrr_db = gain_db - 25
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "swing": swing,
               "slew": sr, "settle": settle, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
               "noise_1k": max(vn_th * 8, 120e-9)}
```
